reviews.title: Great card for the price!
reviews.comment: This graphics card was an easy install, it was well packaged, and so far is performing really well. I’ve been getting over 250 FPS playing some games. It’s been holding up great to games like cyberpunk and games from the DOOM franchise. Super satisfied! It also looks sleek, clean and connected well. It runs great with my 750w power supply, and Ryzen 5700  CPU.
reviews.author: Hannah

reviews.title: Worth it!
reviews.comment: I finally added the Gigabyte RTX 5060 Windforce OC to my build, and it handles everything from high-stakes matches in Marvel Rivals to heavy creative tasks with total ease. The dual-fan design keeps the system incredibly cool and quiet, fitting perfectly into my setup without any clearance issues. While the 8GB of VRAM requires some settings management in heavy apps, the jump in performance and access to DLSS 4 makes it a fantastic upgrade.
reviews.author: Jose Rodriguez

reviews.title: Great GPU for price

reviews.author: Daniel Lamas

reviews.title: Run DDU First
reviews.comment: I had a LOT of trouble getting this card to work with my setup. Ultimately, I got it working so I have to give it 5 stars because it has nothing to do with the card or the manufacturer. AI had me running around in circles chasing non-fixes. Bottom line TLDR: run DDU before you change your GPU. May seem obvious to some, but I didn’t do it. I have an old X570 board with no onboard graphics to fall back on. Fortunately, my old RX480 was still working well enough to run it in the primary PCIe x16 slot while I put this one in the tiny x4 slot. I’m surprised it actually worked enough to recognize the card, run DDU in Safe Mode, swap the cards and reboot. That I believe was the final fix. Before that I was trying everything under the sun from BIOS updates via flash drive (QFlash+), CSM disabled, NVIDIA firmware update tool, the works. I even created a no POST condition where neither card would work. Now that all is said and done everything works great and the card is amazing. Fully tested under Win10 and Win11.
reviews.author: Patt

reviews.title: Great graphics card for the price.
reviews.comment:
Nice affordable upgrade from my 1660. Roughly double the capability.
Sure, it's only got 8gb of ram, and it's not top of the line, but it's a great performance boost for most games at medium to high settings.
